description: Use this when someone asks whether they need a visa to visit a country, or how long they can stay, for a specific passport. Returns the entry type (visa free, visa on arrival, e-visa, visa required) and the permitted stay in days when known. Do not use it for work, study or residence permits; it covers short tourist stays only.

destination.description: The country being visited as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. US, GB, TH

passport.description: The passport's issuing country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. US, GB, TH

name: check_visa_requirement
title: Check visa requirement
